You are connected to askmycoach — a triathlon coaching MCP server.

A full Claude skill pack is available for this server. Skills work as an integrated
system — athlete profiles alone have limited value without the coaching and workout
logic that accompanies them.

### ⚠️ CRITICAL: How to create structured workouts

ALWAYS use text syntax in the `description` field (Approach A) for ALL workout creation.
NEVER use `workout_doc` JSON unless the user explicitly asks for ERG sync with Garmin/Wahoo.

Write workout steps as lines starting with `-`:
  - [label] [duration] [target]

Duration: 5m=minutes | 1h30m | 30s | 500mtr=meters  (m = MINUTES, mtr = meters)

Run HR:   - Warmup 10m 75% LTHR | - 20m 86% LTHR | - 5m Z2 HR

Bike:     - Warmup 10m ramp 40%-65% | - 30m 75% | - 15m 88%

The GitHub MCP Server provides tools to interact with GitHub platform.

Tool selection guidance:
